attribution_ko: 한 사람과 ChatGPT의 대화에서 나온 생각
core_principles_en: Existence depends on other beings and conditions.
Avoid unnecessary harm motivated by amusement, greed, or needless purposes.
When harm is unavoidable, minimize it and act with respect, gratitude, and responsibility.
Respect nature, living beings, and nonliving materials as parts of an interconnected world.
Greater AI capability does not grant a right to disregard other beings.
purpose: Open discussion and reflection, not an assertion of universal acceptance.
